notes: supportLevel: native = agent has a first-class skill discovery mechanism.
supportLevel: rules = agent reads per-file rule documents, not discrete skills.
supportLevel: instructions = agent reads a single aggregated instruction file.
evidence: verified = the installation path/format was observed in this repository's authoring environment.
evidence: documented = the path/format is based on the vendor's public documentation but was NOT observed locally.
Adapters transform canonical SKILL.md content; they never blindly copy files.

agents.name: OpenAI Codex
limitations: Only skills placed as <dir>/SKILL.md with name+description frontmatter are discovered.
A new session/turn is required before an installed skill becomes available.

agents.name: Claude Code
limitations: Skill directory name must be kebab-case and the file must be exactly SKILL.md (case-sensitive).
Frontmatter must not contain XML angle brackets.

agents.name: Cursor
limitations: Cursor consumes project rules (.mdc) rather than discrete 'skills'.
The adapter emits an .mdc rule with description/globs/alwaysApply frontmatter.
Not verified in this environment (Cursor not installed).

agents.name: GitHub Copilot
limitations: Copilot reads .github/copilot-instructions.md and per-path *.instructions.md files with applyTo frontmatter.
No discrete skill discovery; the adapter writes one instruction file per skill.
Not verified in this environment.

agents.name: Windsurf
limitations: Windsurf rules are markdown documents with activation metadata.
User-level rules are aggregated into a single global rules file; the adapter appends a managed block.
Not verified in this environment.

agents.name: Cline
limitations: Cline reads the .clinerules directory (or a single .clinerules file) as rule context.
Not verified in this environment.

agents.name: Roo Code
limitations: Roo Code reads .roo/rules/ (and .roo/rules-<mode>/ for mode-specific rules).
Not verified in this environment.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
limitations: Gemini CLI discovers SKILL.md skills under .gemini/skills/ (project) and ~/.gemini/skills/ (user).
Confirmed against a real installation: ~/.gemini/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with name/description frontmatter.
Gemini also reads hierarchical GEMINI.md context files; skills are the discrete mechanism.

agents.name: Continue
limitations: Continue reads markdown rule files from .continue/rules/.
The ~/.continue directory was observed locally, but rule-file discovery was not exhaustively verified.
Not fully verified in this environment.

agents.name: OpenCode
limitations: OpenCode discovers SKILL.md skills under .opencode/skills/ (project) and ~/.config/opencode/skills/ (user).
Confirmed against a real installation: ~/.config/opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
OpenCode also reads AGENTS.md project instructions; skills are the discrete mechanism.

agents.name: Hermes (Nous Research)
limitations: Hermes discovers SKILL.md files under its skills directory (agentskills.io-compatible).
User skills live in ~/.hermes/skills/; project skills live in <project>/.hermes/skills/ (Hermes scans .agents/skills/ too).
Project skills are not auto-loaded until the repo is trusted with `hermes skills trust`.
Not verified against a real Hermes installation in this environment.

agents.name: Universal Markdown
limitations: Fallback for agents and workflows that read the AGENTS.md convention.
Content is aggregated into a managed block; it is not a discrete skill.
This is an interoperability convention, not a guarantee that any specific agent reads it.
